# Sizing (generated by `scripts/gen_docs.py`)

Analytic plan, **not a measurement**: parameter counts and FLOPs are exact counts of the code; GPU memory is weights + a per-layer activation estimate + 0.8 GB headroom. No GPU was available when this was generated, so no timings are given. Run `h3turbo bench --ckpt ... --measure` on your card.

AdaLN parameters are cached per sampling schedule and kept on the CPU, so they are excluded from GPU memory.
